draw: 2026 controlled hunt draw (100 buck deer, 200 elk, 600 antlerless deer series) and 2026 premium hunt draw
choice_basis: Point hunts: applicants = 1st-choice applicants at each preference-point level (points only count on the 1st choice); drawn = tags drawn at that level in the 75% preference-point phase (ODFW report section B). Tags won in the 25% equal-chance phase by 1st-choice applicants cannot be assigned to a point level, so they are not in the rows; they are given per hunt in the extra field 'random' {res,nr} (= hunt-level 1st-choice drawn minus the phase-1 rows). q.res/q.nr = all 1st-choice applicants drawn (both phases), q.all = tags authorized. Premium hunts: one row in 'all' with points null, applicants = 1st-choice applicants (no residency split), drawn null (ODFW publishes no premium draw results).
